The '''Agriworld-2079 system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within [[M'shinni sector/Legends|M'shinni sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agriworld-2079/Legends|Agriworld-2079]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Skrilling/Legends|Skrilling]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
